description: Search Connecticut's official business registry (published by the Connecticut Secretary of State on the state's open-data portal) by entity name, exact Business ID (account number), business city, or NAICS industry code. Optionally filter by entity status, entity type, and domestic/foreign citizenship.

businessCity.description: Exact business (mailing) address city to browse entities in, e.g. `Hartford`.
businessCity.title: Business city (mode=byCity)

citizenship.description: Optionally restrict results to entities formed in Connecticut (Domestic) or elsewhere (Foreign).
citizenship.title: Domestic / foreign filter

diversityOwnedOnly.description: Return only entities the state records as woman-, veteran-, minority-, disability- or LGBTQI-owned.
diversityOwnedOnly.title: Diversity-owned only

entityId.description: Exact Connecticut Business ID (account number), e.g. `0818011`.
entityId.title: Business ID / account number (mode=byAccountNumber)

entityName.description: Business entity name to search for (substring match), e.g. `WALMART`.
entityName.title: Entity name (mode=byEntityName)

entityStatus.description: Optionally restrict results to a single entity status.
entityStatus.title: Entity status filter

entityType.description: Optionally restrict results to a single entity (business) type.
entityType.title: Entity type filter

formationDateFrom.description: Only entities whose registration/formation date is on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave empty for no lower bound; useful for new-business lead lists.
formationDateFrom.title: Formation date from

formationDateTo.description: Only entities whose registration/formation date is on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave empty for no upper bound.
formationDateTo.title: Formation date to

includeAgents.description: Attach the registered-agent records (name, type, phone, email, addresses) the state publishes for each entity.
includeAgents.title: Include registered agents

includeFilings.description: Attach the full filing-history records for each entity. Adds one extra request per 40 entities.
includeFilings.title: Include filing history

includeNameHistory.description: Attach the name-change history (old name, new name, change date) for each entity where the state publishes it.
includeNameHistory.title: Include name-change history

includePrincipals.description: Attach the principal/officer/director records the state publishes for each entity.
includePrincipals.title: Include principals (officers/directors)

naicsCode.description: North American Industry Classification System code to search for, e.g. `541810`.
naicsCode.title: NAICS code (mode=byNaicsCode)

proxyConfiguration.description: Uses Apify's free datacenter (AUTO) proxy group to get a fresh IP if a request is temporarily blocked. Residential proxy is never used by this actor.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

title: Connecticut Secretary of State Business Search Scraper Input
